sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Serum tumor markers ARE REIMBURSABLE for the following indications: – Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) (CPT code 84078, CPT code 84080) every 90 days for:

subsections.heading:  Metastatic and primary bone neoplasms
content: ▪ ▪ Systemic light chain amyloidosis ▪ Uveal melanoma – B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) or N-terminal fragment of B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) (CPT code 83880*) every 90 days for: ▪ Multiple myeloma – Beta human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) (CPT code 84703, CPT code 84704) every 60 days for: ▪ Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia ▪ Occult primary mass of the mediastinum or retroperitoneum ▪ Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­ Borderline epithelial tumors ­ Malignant germ cell tumors ­ Malignant sex cord stromal tumors ▪ Testicular cancer ▪ Thymoma – Beta-2 microglobulin (B2M) (CPT code 82232) every 90 days for: ▪ B-cell lymphoma or Castleman disease ▪ Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma ▪ Multiple myeloma ▪ Systemic light chain amyloidosis ▪ Waldenström's macroglobulinemia or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma – Calcitonin (CALCA) expression (CPT code 82308) every 60 days for: ▪ Adenocarcinoma or anaplastic epithelial tumors ▪ Multiple endocrine neoplasia, type 2 ▪ Occult primary adenocarcinoma, anaplastic or undifferentiated tumors of the head and neck ▪ Thyroid carcinoma or medullary carcinoma – Circulating serum kappa or lambda free light chains (CPT code 83521) every 90 days for: ▪ Castleman disease ▪ Multiple myeloma ▪ Systemic light chain amyloidosis – Human epididymis protein 4 (HE4) expression (CPT code 86305) every 60 days for: ▪ Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­ Borderline epithelial tumors ­ Carcinosarcoma, also known as malignant mixed Müllerian tumors ­ Clear cell carcinoma of the ovary ­ Grade 1 endometrioid carcinoma ­ Low-grade serous carcinoma ­ Mucinous neoplasms of the ovary ­ Malignant germ cell tumors ­ Malignant sex cord stromal tumors – Inhibin (INHA) expression (CPT code 86336) every 60 days for: ▪ Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­ Borderline epithelial tumors ­ Carcinosarcoma, also known as malignant mix mullerian tumors ­ Clear cell carcinoma of the ovary ­ Grade 1 endometrioid carcinoma ­ Low-grade serous carcinoma ­ Mucinous neoplasms of the ovary ­ Malignant germ cell tumors ­ Malignant sex cord stromal tumors ▪ Unspecified occult primary adenocarcinoma or carcinoma – Troponin T (CPT code 84484) for systemic light chain amyloidosis • All other applications of serum tumor markers (CPT code 82107, CPT code 83950, CPT code 83951, CPT code 86316**) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE . • The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE : ­ BeScreened™-CRC (CPT code 0163U) ­ Divitum® TKa (CPT code 0404U) ­ IGoCheck™ (CPT code 0558U) ­ MammoCheck™ Baseline (CPT code 0559U) ­ Overa OVA1 Next Generation (CPT code 0003U***) ­ PancreaSure™ (CPT code 0599U****) ­ REVEAL Lung Nodule Characterization (CPT code 0092U****) • Analysis of proteomic patterns in serum (CPT code 83789) for screening and detection of cancer IS NOT REIMBURSABLE .

subsections.heading: Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
content: Government Services, Noridian Healthcare Solutions, Palmetto GBA, and Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance Corporation. **The payment criterion for 86316 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to CGS Administrators, Noridian Healthcare Solutions, and Palmetto GBA. ***The payment criterion for 0003U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to CGS Administrators, National Government Services, Noridian Healthcare Solutions, Palmetto GBA, and Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance Corporation. ****The payment criterion for 0092U and 0599U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to CGS Administrators, Noridian Healthcare Solutions, Palmetto GBA, and Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance Corporation.

hormone, human epididymis protein 4, transferrin), utilizing serum, algorithm reported as a likelihood
score
Proprietary test: Overa™ (OVA1 Next Generation)
Lab/manufacturer: Aspira Labs, Inc, Vermillion, Inc

Oncology (lung), three protein biomarkers, immunoassay using magnetic nanosensor technology, plasma,
algorithm reported as risk score for likelihood of malignancy
Proprietary test: REVEAL Lung Nodule Characterization
Lab/manufacturer: MagArray, Inc

Oncology (colorectal) screening, biochemical enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) of 3 plasma or
serum proteins (teratocarcinoma derived growth factor-1 [TDGF-1, Cripto-1], carcinoembryonic antigen
[CEA], extracellular matrix protein [ECM]), with demographic data (age, gender, CRC-screening
compliance) using a proprietary algorithm and reported as likelihood of CRC or advanced adenomas
Proprietary test: BeScreened™-CRC
Lab/Manufacturer: Beacon Biomedical Inc

Oncology (breast), semiquantitative measurement of thymidine kinase activity by immunoassay, serum,
results reported as risk of disease progression
Proprietary test: DiviTum®TKa
Lab/Manufacturer: Biovica Inc, Biovica International AB

Oncology (colorectal), quantitative enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for secreted colorectal
cancer protein marker (BF7 antigen), using serum, result reported as indicative of response/no response
to therapy or disease progression/regression
Proprietary test: IGoCheck™
Lab/Manufacturer: Milagen, Inc, Milagen, Inc

Oncology (breast), quantitative enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) for secreted breast cancer
protein marker (BF9 antigen), serum, result reported as indicative of response/no response to therapy or
disease progression/regression
Proprietary test: MammoCheck™ (Blood-Based Breast Cancer Test)
Lab/Manufacturer: Milagen, Inc, Milagen, Inc

Oncology (pancreatic cancer), multiplex immunoassay of ICAM1, TIMP1, CTSD, THBS1, and CA 19-9,
serum, diagnostic algorithm reported as positive or negative

Proprietary test: PancreaSure™
Lab/Manufacturer: Immunovia, Inc, Immunovia, Inc
